description: Enterprise-approved Playwright (JavaScript) blueprint: page-object model, shared fixtures, data-driven oracle files, JSON+HTML reporting, TIM traceability annotations.

conventions.class_naming: PascalCase, one page object per file under pages/
conventions.locator_style: Locator fields initialized in the constructor; dynamic locators as parameterized methods
conventions.waits: Rely on Playwright auto-waiting; explicit waits only where the legacy framework encoded a real timing quirk
conventions.test_entry: Shared business flows are fixtures under fixtures/, never repeated in specs
conventions.test_data: Oracle data in testdata/*.json, loaded through utils/test-data-loader.js
conventions.traceability: Every generated spec carries TIM id in the title plus source/TIM annotations

patterns.name: poll-populated-select
patterns.purpose: Dropdowns that populate their options via AJAX after first render

patterns.name: conditional-dismiss
patterns.purpose: Interstitials/nags that may or may not appear

patterns.name: autocomplete-retry-search
patterns.purpose: Autocomplete widgets that need real key events and can miss the first keystroke burst

patterns.name: scoped-component
patterns.purpose: Reading fields from a repeated card/row component matched by its title text
patterns.implementation: locator().filter({ has: ... }) container + scoped child locators
